title: Rice genomic selection: frozen-prediction reproduction

creators.name: Li, Jixiao
creators.affiliation: Field Science Center for Northern Biosphere, Hokkaido University

description: Minimal empirical frozen-prediction reproduction for original NAM, MAGIC and IRRI comparisons, NAM four-strategy and fixed-penalty analyses, and two IRRI partition policies. Includes author-generated predictions and exact scoring identities; original source phenotypes are supplied locally by the user. No refitting or retuning. Software MIT; author-generated prediction/result resources CC BY 4.0; source identity attributions are documented in README.
